consistency_rules: contact_campaigns must contain unique contact_id and campaign_id pairs.
The generated bridge must include contacts in multiple campaigns and campaigns with multiple contacts.
Each contact may have at most one primary campaign attribution.
Before imperfection injection, attribution weights for each contact must sum to 1.0000.
When interactions.account_id is populated, it must equal the referenced contact account_id.
When interactions.campaign_id is populated, the same contact_id and campaign_id pair must exist in contact_campaigns.
Campaign end_date must be null or on or after start_date.
Campaign touches must be ordered and remain within the applicable campaign window.
Support-case contacts must belong to the same account as the case when contact_id is populated.
Support-case SLA deadlines are derived from opened_at and priority using calendar hours.
Resolved and Closed cases require resolved_at; unresolved statuses require resolved_at to be null.
All campaign currency_code values must equal USD.
